See yourself at Twilio
Join the team as our next Senior Customer Success Manager on Twilio’s Segment team.

The Customer Success Management team at Twilio is the central touchpoint for our customers, orchestrating the post-sales customer lifecycle in partnership with professional services, sales and support.

The team manages the customer relationship, coordinates internally within Twilio, drives product adoption and guides the customer to take full advantage of our ecosystem. Fundamentally, the CSM team ensures customers derive value from our platform, and ultimately renew and grow their relationships with us.
As a Senior Customer Success Manager, Key accounts you will be at the forefront of driving customer satisfaction for our largest customers by developing tailored strategies that align with both customer goals and company objectives.

Your work will directly impact customer retention and growth, as you will solve complex challenges, influence strategic decisions and advocate for customer needs across executive stakeholders. We are looking for CSMs who are passionate about first party data and how it can transform organizations.

As a CSM, you will have the opportunity to help some of the world’s most influential companies solve their toughest data and communication problems. So if you get excited about things like defining culture and process, you may be the Customer Success Manager we’re looking for!

Ensure customer success by driving full value realization of the platform.
Identify customer business outcomes and their aligned value metrics.
Develop and execute strategic roadmaps for product adoption, customer satisfaction, and advocacy.
Manage the customer relationship, acting as a trusted advisor to executive and senior leadership in Engineering, Product, Business Analytics, and Marketing.
Cultivate strong relationships with IT, engineering, and development teams to drive engagement.
Identify and expand opportunities to deepen customer engagement and account growth.
Collaborate with internal teams to optimize implementations and resolve complex technical challenges.
Build and nurture new stakeholder relationships to unlock expansion opportunities.
Partner with Sales on account renewals and expansion strategies.
Analyze your portfolio to prioritize high-impact risks and opportunities.
Proactively identify risks, prioritize opportunities, and develop mitigation plans for high-impact accounts.
Become a platform expert while staying current with industry trends in data and analytics.
Ensure execution of customer maturity and technical discussions via coordinating solutions internally across engineering, marketing, product, and support teams.

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Webflow is the agentic web marketing platform for modern marketing teams, helping organizations build, manage, and optimize high-performing web experiences that drive predictable growth and strengthen brand trust. Building at Webflow will need grit, because we move fast, without ever sacrificing craft or quality.
Our Customer Success team works with Webflow’s most high-impact customers, helping them launch successfully, adapt quickly, and get the full value of our AI-native website experience platform. We’re the team that stays with customers from day one through renewal, guiding their strategy, unblocking their teams, and connecting them with the right experts across Webflow.
As the primary partner for our accounts, we play a central role in their long-term success and in Webflow’s. By driving adoption, uncovering new use cases, and championing meaningful outcomes, we influence growth, retention, and the overall strength of our business.
We’re looking for a Customer Success Manager who can step into that role with confidence: the trusted advisor who sees the big picture, the operator who can bring cross-functional teams together, and the advocate who ensures customers stay with us and grow with us because of the results we help them achieve.

Location: Remote-first (United States; BC, Canada)
Must be based in the Pacific time zone
Full-time

Exempt

As a Customer Success Manager, you’ll …
Build strong working relationships with your customers’ day-to-day teams and key stakeholders, becoming a reliable partner throughout their Webflow journey.
Learn each customer’s goals and workflows so you can guide them toward meaningful wins with Webflow’s AI-native website experience platform.
Support account strategy by helping customers adopt core features, implement best practices, and stay on track with their success plans.
Partner closely with Account Executives and Solutions Engineers to deliver a smooth onboarding experience and drive ongoing adoption of new features.
Run customer check-ins and business reviews that highlight progress, unblock issues, and uncover opportunities for deeper engagement.
Own full execution of the renewal process for your book of business, from forecasting through close to protect and grow recurring revenue.
Bring clear, organized customer insights back to the business to help improve our product, processes and overall experience.
Travel up to 15% (1-2x per quarter)

3+ years prior experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a client-facing role in SaaS, digital experiences, or an agency environment.
Familiarity with the marketing and digital experience landscape e.g. CMS platforms, martech/analytics tools, SEO fundamentals, or campaign workflows and how they connect to business outcomes.
Experience managing a book of accounts where you balanced competing priorities, responded quickly to customer needs and kept work moving.
Solid organizational and project-management habits that help you stay prepared, document clearly and follow through reliably.
Strong technical aptitude, with demonstrated ability to quickly learn and confidently navigate complex technical products, web technologies and workflow tools.
Proven track record owning renewals and/or contributing to expansion revenue in a former role with comfort operating against commercial targets like NRR.

s.t:
Take a consultative approach and ask thoughtful questions, learn quickly, and enjoy helping customers solve real problems.
Communicate clearly and confidently, especially when explaining technical concepts or guiding a customer through next steps.
Are willing to dive into a technical product and learn how to support customers across a range of web and workflow use cases.
Stay curious and open to growth — demonstrating a proactive embrace of AI, and actively building and applying fluency in emerging technologies to elevate how we work, drive faster outcomes, and expand collective impact

Build lasting customer trust. We build trust by taking action that puts customer trust first.
Win together. We play to win, and we win as one team. Success at Webflow isn't a solo act.
Reinvent ourselves. We don't just improve what exists, we imagine what's possible.
Own it all the way. We move fast because the moment demands it, and we hold ourselves accountable to deliver outcomes — for each other, and for customers.

Ownership in what you help build. Every permanent Webflower receives equity (RSUs) in our growing, privately held company.

Support for every stage of family life . 12 weeks of paid parental leave for all parents and 6+ weeks of additional paid leave for birthing parents. Plus inclusive care for family planning, menopause, and midlife transitions.
Time off that’s actually off. Flexible vacation, paid holidays, and a sabbatical program to help you recharge and come back inspired.
Wellness for the whole you. Access to mental health resources, therapy and coaching.

Monthly stipends that flex with your life. Localized support for work and wellness expenses — from Wi-Fi to workouts.

As a Customer Success Manager for APJ, you’ll help GitLab customers realize the full value of our intelligent DevSecOps platform by driving adoption, measurable outcomes, and long-term advocacy across the region.

You’ll serve as a trusted advisor to a portfolio of customers, guiding them on Git, branching strategies, software development lifecycle practices, continuous integration, continuous deployment, and DevSecOps best practices.

In this role, you’ll connect customer goals with GitLab capabilities, lead workshops and Center of Excellence efforts, and turn product usage data into clear, actionable recommendations for both customers and GitLab account teams.

You’ll work closely with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and Professional Services, and you’ll measure your success in your first year through customer satisfaction, retention, and the strength of the strategic relationships you build in APJ.

This is an opportunity to help customers achieve meaningful business outcomes while strengthening trust in GitLab through consistent, value-focused partnership.

Helping customers improve adoption of GitLab across their software development lifecycle through structured success plans and workshops
Partnering with account teams and cross-functional stakeholders to turn usage insights into recommendations that support customer outcomes, retention, and growth

Build and maintain trusted advisor relationships with assigned customers across APJ, with a focus on adoption, measurable outcomes, and long-term satisfaction with GitLab.
Help customers with deployment guidance, operational best practices, and establishing a GitLab Center of Excellence within their organization.
Lead and participate in workshops that help customers understand and use the value of GitLab across their software development lifecycle.
Measure and monitor customer progress against critical performance indicators, and share insights with GitLab account stakeholders as well as customer sponsors and executives.
Turn customer product usage data into clear, actionable recommendations that support broader adoption and expansion of GitLab within customer environments.
Establish and manage regular customer touchpoints in line with service expectations to review strategic and technical objectives and adjust plans as needed.
Collaborate closely with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and Professional Services to support issue resolution, share customer feedback, and align on customer success plans.
Contribute regional insight from APJ customer engagements to help improve how GitLab supports customers across different markets, business needs, and stages of maturity.

Experience in a customer-facing role focused on post-sales adoption, value realization, and customer advocacy.
Background in customer success, professional services, technical account management, or a related function with direct customer engagement.
Ability to understand and discuss Git, common branching strategies, and how customers use version control in their workflows.
Knowledge of the software development lifecycle, including common development pipelines and tooling.
Familiarity with continuous integration, continuous deployment, and DevSecOps concepts and practices.
Skill in turning product usage data and technical details into clear, actionable insights for both technical and executive stakeholders.
Proven ability to build trusted advisor relationships, facilitate workshops, and guide customers through best practices and operational change.
Openness to learning, with transferable skills from adjacent roles or industries that support collaborative, outcome-focused customer partnerships in the APJ region.
The Customer Success Management team at GitLab supports customers across regions by helping them navigate change, improve how they work, and make the most of the GitLab DevSecOps platform.
As a globally distributed, all-remote team, we collaborate asynchronously with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Professional Services, and other teams to connect customer needs with GitLab’s product and services.

We focus on helping customers establish GitLab best practices, including Centers of Excellence, and on using data and customer context to support strategic and technical goals. In APJ, this role helps bring regional perspective to those efforts while working as part of a broader team that values collaboration , transparency , and results .

About Dutchie
Founded in 2017, Dutchie is a comprehensive technology platform powering dispensary operations, while providing consumers with safe and easy access to cannabis.

Dutchie aims to further support the positive societal change the cannabis industry brings to the world through wellness benefits, social justice, and empowering local communities through tax revenue.

Powering thousands of dispensaries across 40+ markets throughout the United States and Canada, Dutchie is the leading technology company in the cannabis space and was named in Fast Company’s 10 Most Innovative Companies in North America and listed two years in a row on LinkedIn’s Top 50 Startups.
Dutchie has raised over $600M in funding to date, backed by D1 Capital Partners, Tiger Global, Dragoneer, DFJ Growth, Thrive Capital, Howard Schultz, Snoop Dogg’s Casa Verde Capital, Gron Ventures, members of the founding team at DoorDash, Kevin Durant’s Thirty Five Ventures, and other notable angel investors.
About This Job
As an SMB Customer Success Manager (CSM) at Dutchie, you'll be part of an Account Team — partnered with Account Managers in a pod structure — focused on making sure our dispensary customers are successful as a business. Account health, retention, and churn risk ownership are at the core of what we do.

In Dutchie's model, Account Managers own the commercial relationship — renewals, pricing, and expansion — while CSMs own the churn lifecycle and customer health: identifying risk early, building save plans, and setting Account Managers up to win renewals well before the selling motion begins.

CSMs pull context together across our internal teams (Support, Implementation, Solutions, Engineering, and Product) so customers always have someone keeping track of feedback, open requests, and high-priority issues. The focus is proactive risk mitigation, not reactive support — CSMs are not a ticket queue, and we protect that line deliberately.

Operate as part of an Account Team pod, partnering closely with Account Managers on account strategy — you own customer health and the churn lifecycle; they own renewals and commercial growth.
Own the renewal runway: monitor accounts in the 90-day renewal window, flag at-risk accounts early, and have save plans in motion so Account Managers enter renewal conversations with no surprises.
Manage churn risk end to end — triage, mitigation strategy, and resolution — partnering cross-functionally to remove blockers.
Proactively monitor account health signals (engagement, product usage, billing indicators) and act on them before they become escalations.
Pull context together across Product, Support, Sales, Solutions, and Implementation so customer feedback, open requests, and high-priority issues never go unanswered.
Act as a strategic resource for customers — sourcing answers, guiding best practices, and finding paths (features, early-access programs, alternative solutions) when customers are stuck on a problem.
Contribute to process improvements and team initiatives as we build out our pod operating model.
Meet or exceed team KPIs: same-day customer response, quarterly engagement on every account, and pod-level net revenue retention.

3–5 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a related client-facing role (SaaS or technology industry preferred).
Experience managing churn risk and retention motions — you've owned saves, not just flagged them.
Comfort operating in a shared-accountability model where your performance is measured alongside a team (pod-level metrics), with growing autonomy in commercial conversations.
Strong technical aptitude and problem-solving skills; able to source or solution answers independently.
Excellent communication, organizational, and prioritization abilities — you can run multiple active risk situations without dropping threads.
Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams (Product, Support, Sales, Implementation).
Proactive, ownership-driven approach with a focus on continuous improvement.
Knowledge of the cannabis industry is a plus, but not required
You’ll Get…
We are targeting a starting salary of $55,000 - $75,000 based on the intended level for this role.
In addition to cash compensation, our total rewards package includes:
Full medical benefits, including dental and vision plans to ensure you always have the best care.
Equity packages in the form of stock options to all employees.
Technology (hardware, software, reading materials, etc..) allowance
Flexible vacation and sick days

The Health Management Academy (THMA) brings together health system leaders and innovators to collectively address the industry’s biggest challenges and opportunities. By assisting executives in cultivating peer networks, understanding key strategic trends, establishing pragmatic partnerships, and developing next-generation leaders, our members are better positioned to lead industry transformation.
The Health Management Academy offers a dynamic atmosphere with significant opportunities for employees. If you are interested in contributing to a member-centric, creative, and collaborative workforce while deeply influencing top leaders and institutions in healthcare, THMA could be the right place for you!
Position Overview The Health Management Academy brings together health-system leaders and healthcare innovators to navigate the industry's most important challenges. We help executives build trusted peer relationships, understand strategic trends, form practical partnerships, and develop the next generation of healthcare leaders.

Provelle, part of The Health Management Academy , builds software that helps healthcare leaders make better decisions, strengthen their organizations, and become more effective leaders. We are a small, collaborative team with the opportunity to shape both the products we build and the impact they have across healthcare.

Embley is our AI-enabled leadership-support platform for frontline nurse managers. It helps managers work through difficult situations, practice critical conversations, and build leadership skills in the flow of work - while giving health-system leaders better visibility into where their teams need support.

The Senior Customer Success Manager will own implementation and adoption across Provelle's health-system customers. This is not a relationship-maintenance role. You will be accountable for getting complex organizations live, helping the product become part of managers' day-to-day work, and demonstrating meaningful value to executive sponsors.

You will spend time with customers in the field, solve problems that do not yet have a playbook, and help us build a repeatable customer-success model. This is a senior individual-contributor role with no direct reports to start. Primary Job Duties
Health-system implementations end to end. Lead customers from sales handoff through discovery, planning, configuration, training, go-live, stabilization, and sustained adoption.
Frontline adoption. Understand how nurse managers actually work, identify the barriers preventing behavior change, and create practical programs that make Embley useful in the moments that matter.
Executive relationships. Build credibility with CNEs, CNOs, nursing leaders, learning and development teams, IT partners, and other executive sponsors. Run steering conversations, communicate risk clearly, and keep stakeholders aligned.
Customer outcomes. Establish success plans, define measurable outcomes, monitor product engagement and customer health, and connect usage to the priorities that led the customer to choose Embley.
Training and launch support. Facilitate executive kickoffs, manager training, onsite launch activities, office hours, and follow-up programs. During major launches, you should expect to be close to the customer and highly hands-on.
Escalations and problem-solving. Identify issues early, take ownership when something goes off track, and coordinate across product, engineering, sales, and customer stakeholders to resolve them.
The customer-success operating system. Build the implementation plans, handoffs, health indicators, reporting rhythms, adoption programs, and playbooks that will allow us to serve more health systems without losing the quality of the customer experience.
The voice of the customer. Bring structured insight back to the product team. Distinguish between one-off requests and recurring customer needs, and help us make better product and operating decisions.

A senior implementation and customer-success operator. You likely have 6-9 years of relevant experience, including 3-5 years personally leading complex healthcare or enterprise technology implementations. We care more about what you have owned than an exact number of years.
Experienced with health systems. You have worked directly with hospitals or health systems through healthcare SaaS, implementation services, consulting, clinical transformation, or a similar environment. You understand that decisions involve many stakeholders and that frontline adoption cannot be managed from a project plan alone.
Accountable beyond go-live. You do not consider a launch successful because training was completed or a checklist was closed. You stay engaged until customers are using the product, sponsors can see the value, and the implementation is positioned for retention and growth.
Credible in the executive room and useful on the hospital floor. You can lead a concise conversation with a senior nursing executive, then work directly with nurse managers to understand why a workflow is not landing.
Strong at change management. You know how to diagnose resistance, activate champions, tailor communication to different audiences, and help customers turn a new tool into a sustained way of working.
Operationally rigorous. You create clear plans, identify dependencies, maintain decision and risk logs, communicate changes early, and make sure important details do not disappear between teams.
Comfortable with data. You can use engagement, adoption, milestone, and customer-health data to identify problems and guide action. You also know when the numbers need to be supplemented with direct customer observation.
Technically fluent enough to lead the work. You do not need to be an engineer, but you can discuss integrations, data requirements, authentication, product configuration, and technical constraints with customer IT teams and internal partners.
Effective in an early-stage environment. You can operate without a mature process, make sound decisions with incomplete information, and improve the system while continuing to deliver for customers.
A clear, direct communicator. You write well, facilitate productive meetings, and can deliver difficult updates without creating unnecessary confusion or drama.
Preferred Qualifications Nursing, clinical, or healthcare-operations background. Work Environment and Travel
Remote, but not distant from customers. This role can be based anywhere in the United States within reasonable access - approximately one hour - to a major commercial airport. Central or Eastern Time is preferred, though we will consider exceptional candidates elsewhere.
Customer travel is part of the job. Expect approximately 30-50% travel, with more concentrated periods around implementations and launches.
Small team, direct communication. You will work closely with sales, product, engineering, and company leadership
High ownership and high trust. We hire people who can understand the goal, determine what needs to happen, and carry the work through to a strong result.

The Joblogic Story
Established in 1998, Joblogic is the UK’s #1 Field Service Management (FSM) software platform. We are a global business with offices in the UK , Pakistan , and Vietnam . Since our management buy-out in 2013, we have grown from ~£500K ARR to ~£35M+ ARR and expanded our team from 11 to 500+ people.
Recently, we secured a strategic growth investment from Vista Equity Partners — a global technology investor specialising in enterprise software. This investment includes over £100 million in new primary capital and will fuel our next phase of growth by accelerating our AI-first roadmap , expanding our platform into CAFM (Computer-Aided Facilities Management) capabilities, and supporting our expansion across Europe and beyond.
With Vista’s backing, we’re transforming from a successful UK business into a global scaling SaaS rocket ship, and we’d love for you to join us on our journey to £100M ARR across international markets.
Joblogic provides software to service contractors who install and maintain the built environment. Our platform helps businesses streamline operations, improve profitability, ensure compliance, and achieve rapid growth. With over 100,000 users across industries including HVAC, plumbing, electrical maintenance, facilities management, and building fabric maintenance, we are entering a new era of intelligent automation, predictive maintenance, and data-driven decision-making for service firms.

As Senior Customer Success Manager, Strategic Accounts, you will own a portfolio of Joblogic’s most complex, high-value enterprise customers — accountable for retention, expansion, and long-term value realisation across every account in your book.
This is not a reactive support role. You will operate as a trusted commercial partner to your customers — diagnosing value gaps, influencing senior stakeholders, building structured success plans, and driving the adoption that leads directly to retention and growth. You will be expected to identify and close expansion opportunities independently, lead executive-level commercial conversations, and protect revenue through deep understanding of customer outcomes.
You will sit within Joblogic’s newly built Strategic CS function, working closely with the Senior Manager, Strategic Accounts and partnering with Sales, Product, Implementation, and Support as the business scales internationally.

Mission
You intrinsically care about ensuring business owners succeed. As our Customer Success Manager:in at Integral Tax GmbH Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft, you own the client experience from signed quote to a mandate that runs smoothly: onboarding, identity verification (KYC), know your business (KYB), platform adoption, and early churn prevention.
Integral Group was founded in October 2024 and is one of Germany's fastest-growing startups. We're building one of the leading AI-native platforms for accounting, payroll, and tax for business owners. We combine our digital platform with the expertise of tax advisors and auditors.

When a founder or managing director of a GmbH or UG needs something to move, you're the person they trust. If you want real ownership of a client base, and you'd rather build the playbook than inherit one, this is your opportunity of the decade.
Your Tasks
Own the Sales-to-Service handoff: Take full context from Sales: each client's core challenges, prior-advisor situation, expectations, and business goals. Know the mandate cold before onboarding starts.
Run onboarding end to end: Guide clients through platform registration, document upload and identity verification, engagement-letter signature, and data takeover from their previous tax advisor. Coordinate final approval with Tax Operations and our Wirtschaftsprüfer.
Execute KYC/KYB checks: Collect and verify identification, documentation, and information. Pre-check our client-acceptance (exclusion) criteria, assign risk classifications, and coordinate every step to a final decision.
Drive platform adoption: Run intro walkthroughs, teach clients how to navigate the platform, set a check-in cadence, and make sure they actually use it: document uploads, task responses, approvals.
Prevent early churn: Monitor the onboarding funnel and engagement signals, own and coordinate mitigation for at-risk clients with Sales and Tax Operations, and make sure we deliver before a client thinks about leaving.
Your Profile
3+ years in Customer Success, client onboarding, implementation, or account management in a B2B environment. SaaS, fintech, or professional services (tax, accounting, audit) is a strong plus.
German at full professional fluency (C1+) is required, because our clients communicate in German. Fluent English for internal collaboration.
Experience with regulated, compliance-heavy processes. Familiarity with KYC/KYB and AML (GwG) is a strong plus. At minimum, you execute precise, documented, checklist-driven work without dropping a thread.
You write well. Client emails that are clear, warm, and precise, and internal documentation clean enough for the next person to act on.
Comfortable in a CRM, Slack, and Notion, and quick to master whatever internal platform we put in front of you.
High empathy and real de-escalation skill. A frustrated client ends the call or email feeling taken care of.
High context and high agency. You work across Sales, Tax Operations, and Engineering, chase open threads to closure, and push back where a process creates friction instead of removing it.

About Wolt
At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.
Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.
Our Onboarding Operations team lies at the heart of Wolt, bringing together specialized subteams to set every merchant up for success. Within Onboarding Operations, our Data Validation team acts as the crucial gatekeeper between Sales and Merchant Onboarding—ensuring every business detail, legal document, and data point is verified and compliant before a restaurant goes live.
As a Data Validation Specialist , you will take ownership of compliance checks for key accounts and non-standard setups across the German market. You’ll serve as the bridge that ensures Sales submits accurate merchant data and that our Onboarding colleagues receive partners that are fully vetted and ready for a smooth kickoff.
If you have a sharp eye for detail, love solving operational puzzles, and want to play a key role in scaling Wolt’s merchant pipeline, we’d love to chat.
What you’ll be doing
Act as the Gatekeeper: Review, verify, and approve incoming merchant data and legal documentation from Sales to ensure full compliance before handing partners over to the Onboarding team.
Handle Priority Accounts: Take ownership of data verification for key partners, enterprise accounts, or complex business structures requiring specialized compliance checks.
Bridge Sales & Onboarding: Work closely within Onboarding Operations to bridge the gap between Sales and Onboarding —resolving data discrepancies and ensuring seamless handovers.
Serve as a Compliance Resource: Act as a go-to person on German merchant documentation, local business regulations, and Wolt's internal verification requirements.
Improve Subteam Workflows: Identify recurring data errors or bottlenecks in the handover process and help drive small-to-medium workflow improvements to keep operations fast and reliable.
Maintain System Integrity: Monitor compliance cases and track pipelines using Monday.com and internal Wolt software to keep error rates low.
Support & Mentor: Help train new colleagues within the Data Validation subteam, maintain team documentation, and share best practices across Onboarding Operations.
Our humble expectations
Relevant Experience: 1–3 years of experience in merchant compliance, quality control, or back-office operations—ideally in a fast-paced tech or e-commerce environment.
Compliance Mindset: Solid understanding of German business documentation, commercial registers, and standard merchant verification requirements.
Detail-Oriented & Solution-Focused: Exceptional attention to detail with a pragmatic, problem-solving mindset to help Sales fix data issues without delaying the timeline.
Strong Communication: Great interpersonal skills—able to hold high quality standards firmly while collaborating smoothly with internal teams and external merchants.
Process-Driven: Comfortable managing workflows in tools like Monday.com or CRMs, with an eye for making daily operations more efficient.
Language Skills: Fluent written and spoken German (C1) and good professional working English .
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Experience scaling accounts in high-growth startups.

Help Universities Discover Human Potential. Become a Trusted Partner.
The best customer relationships begin with trust: understanding what a partner is trying to achieve, helping them work through difficult challenges, and showing up with insights when it matters.
At Acuity Insights , those conversations happen in a uniquely meaningful context. We partner with higher education institutions making some of the most important decisions they’ll make: who gets the opportunity to enter a profession, how potential is understood beyond grades alone, and how learners are supported throughout their journey.
As our next Customer Success Manager, you’ll build trusted partnerships with admissions leaders, educators, and program teams, helping them realize the full value of our products while uncovering new opportunities to deepen those relationships over time.
This is a Customer Success role where helping customers realize long-term value naturally leads to renewals, growth, and lasting partnerships. The difference is how you get there. Our strongest partnerships grow because customers trust our guidance, see meaningful outcomes, and choose to deepen their relationship with us over time.
If you enjoy turning thoughtful conversations into trusted partnerships and meaningful growth, you’ll find work here that reaches far beyond the account itself.
This is a fully remote role open to candidates based anywhere in Canada.
Before you apply: Thoughtful use of AI is encouraged. If you use it to support your application, please make sure it helps communicate your experience clearly and accurately. The strongest applications are authentic, original, and unmistakably yours.
The Work You’ll Do
In your first few weeks, you’ll immerse yourself in our customers’ world. You’ll learn how admissions and learner development work across higher education, get to know the institutions in your portfolio, and build a deep understanding of the challenges they’re trying to solve.
You’ll gradually take ownership of your portfolio, giving you the opportunity to understand each institution, build meaningful relationships, and grow your confidence before independently managing your full portfolio. You’ll have the autonomy to own your customer relationships while knowing you’ll always have experienced teammates to collaborate with as you begin leading customer conversations, supporting renewals, and identifying opportunities to create value for the institutions you support.
You’ll support a diverse portfolio of higher education institutions across North America, building long-term relationships with admissions leaders, educators, and program teams. While much of your work happens remotely, you’ll also have opportunities to meet customers in person through campus visits, conferences, and industry events because some of the strongest partnerships are built face to face. Your workday will naturally align with the time zones of the customers you support.
As your confidence grows, you’ll become a strategic partner to your customers. You’ll lead renewal conversations, identify opportunities for growth, and help institutions navigate new challenges as their needs evolve. You’ll connect customer needs with the broader capabilities of Acuity, helping institutions get more value from the solutions they use today while identifying opportunities where we can support them in new ways.
You’ll also join us at an exciting point in the evolution of Customer Success at Acuity. We’re intentionally building a more strategic, and customer-centered approach to partnering with our institutions. You’ll help shape that evolution by working closely with Sales, Product, and cross-functional teams to strengthen the customer experience and contribute to the next chapter of Customer Success.
What You’ll Help Make Possible
The relationships you build will have an impact far beyond your own portfolio. You’ll help higher education institutions get more value from their partnership with Acuity while contributing directly to our growth and the continued evolution of Customer Success.
Build partnerships customers want to grow.
Develop trusted, long-term relationships that help institutions achieve meaningful outcomes and choose to continue growing with Acuity year after year.

More about Nash
Nash is the platform that powers modern logistics.
Commerce has inverted. For decades, customers came to where products and services were. Now products and services come to them, on their terms, in real time. That shift has turned every company into a logistics company, even though almost none of them were built to be one.

Couriers, fleets, gig workers, parcel carriers, in-store labor, and increasingly autonomous systems all have to be coordinated in real time, against tighter windows and rising expectations, with hard-fought customer trust on the line.
Nash unifies decisioning, execution, and capacity into a single programmable platform. Real-time, AI-native intelligence determines what should happen, operational control executes it, and the platform dynamically orchestrates capacity from any source: a company's own fleets, partners, or the Nash delivery network.

Whether a job involves a courier, a gig driver, an internal fleet, a store employee, a technician, or an autonomous vehicle, Nash selects the right resource and manages execution through completion.
We power delivery and logistics for some of the most recognizable brands in commerce, including Walmart, Urban Outfitters, 7-Eleven, and Woolworths, alongside platforms like Shopify and Toast. Over the next decade, logistics will become as foundational to commerce as payments, cloud, and connectivity. Nash is the platform that powers it.
Nash was founded in 2021 by Mahmoud Ghulman (2x Founder, MIT) and Aziz Alghunaim (2x Founder, 2x YC, Ex-Palantir, MIT) and is backed by Y Combinator, a16z, and other top investors. We are headquartered in San Francisco.

Deine High-Speed Mission Zu Speed Kit
Speed Kit macht die Shops und Websites unserer Kunden messbar schneller, und schnellere Seiten heißen mehr Umsatz. Zu unseren Kunden gehören einige der bekanntesten E-Commerce-Marken in Deutschland und Europa.
Zu deiner Rolle
Customer Success bei uns ist deshalb keine Zufriedenheitsverwaltung, sondern die Verantwortung dafür, dass ein Kunde live geht, den Effekt auf sein Geschäft nachvollziehen kann und langfristig bleibt. Die initiale Unterschrift holen unsere Account Executives. Danach sitzt du im Driver Seat: Du bringst den Kunden durch Trial oder POC über die Ziellinie und behältst ihn anschließend in deinem Portfolio. Der Kunde bleibt deiner, mit allem was dazugehört.
Was du verantwortest
Du führst Trials und POCs deiner Neukunden: Du steuerst Integration und Konfiguration mit unserem Team und dem Kunden, koordinierst A/B-Test-Setup und Auswertung und hältst die Stakeholder zusammen. Du erkennst früh, wenn ein Projekt kippt, und drehst es.
Du führst die Onboarding-Projekte als echte Projektleitung, von Kickoff über Go-live bis zur Ergebnispräsentation. Das ist der Schwerpunkt der Rolle.
Du betreust deine Bestandskunden aus eigenem Antrieb. Du gehst auf deine Accounts zu, bevor sie sich melden, kennst ihre Roadmap und ihre Relaunches und bringst regelmäßig Ergebnisse und Ideen an den Tisch.
Du trägst Umsatzverantwortung für dein Portfolio: Verlängerungen, Commitment-Upgrades, Überschreitungen, Ausbau in weitere Domains, Marken und Länder. Du weißt jederzeit, wo dein Book steht und warum. Und weil dein Erfolg unser Erfolg ist, profitierst du auch entsprechend davon.
Du führst Kundengespräche auf Basis von Daten: Core Web Vitals, CrUX, Conversion-Uplift, ROI. Du kannst einen Uplift erklären und auch eine Verschlechterung, ohne auszuweichen.
Du arbeitest täglich mit AI. Analysen, Reporting, Datenrecherche über unsere Systeme, Entwürfe für Kundenkommunikation: das machst du mit Claude und Gemini und baust dir eigene wiederverwendbare Workflows dafür. Wir erwarten kein Coding, aber wir erwarten, dass du dir selbst Hebel baust, statt Dinge manuell abzuarbeiten.
Du bist die Spinne im Netz. Niemand im Unternehmen weiß so viel über unsere Kunden wie du, und du bringst dieses Wissen in alle Teams, von Engineering und Product über Sales bis zur Geschäftsführung.
Wie es bei uns wirklich läuft
Das Customer Success Team ist eine kleine, extrem eingespielte Truppe und liefert unseren Kunden echten, messbaren Mehrwert. Das ist eine High-Impact-Rolle: Was du bewegst, ist sofort sichtbar, im Ergebnis des Kunden und in unseren Zahlen.

Dazu extrem flache Hierarchien, kein Freigabetheater, direkte Gespräche mit Engineering, Product und Geschäftsführung. Was du entscheidest, gilt. Dafür brauchst du aber auch eine eigene Meinung und den Mut, sie auszusprechen. Wenn du etwas anders siehst, sagst du es, und du bleibst dabei, auch wenn jemand widerspricht.
Wir haben mehr Projekte als Hände. Ein Teil deiner Woche wird von außen bestimmt, deshalb ist gute Triage entscheidend: Du erkennst, welches der zehn offenen Themen heute Umsatz bewegt oder einen Kunden hält, und was warten kann. Du bekommst von uns Ziele, Kontext und Rückendeckung, aber niemand sortiert deine Prioritäten für dich.

Dazu gehört auch, dass du den Mund aufmachst, wenn es brennt: nicht bei jeder Unsicherheit, sondern nachdem du selbst ernsthaft versucht hast, das Problem zu lösen. Keine Probleme, die drei Wochen im Stillen wachsen, und keine Eskalation für jede Frage, die du selbst beantworten könntest.

Erfahrung mit oder klare Bereitschaft zu echter Umsatzverantwortung. Du willst, dass dein Ergebnis an Kundenerfolg hängt, statt es zu vermeiden.
AI-Tools als tägliches Arbeitsmittel. Das ist harte Voraussetzung und kein Pluspunkt. Wir werden dich im Bewerbungsprozess bitten, konkret zu zeigen, was du mit Claude, Gemini oder vergleichbaren Tools gebaut oder automatisiert hast. "Ich nutze ChatGPT manchmal für E-Mails" reicht dafür nicht.
Selbstbewusstsein und Standing. Du trittst gegenüber Entscheidern auf Augenhöhe auf, führst auch unangenehme Gespräche über Preise, Verzögerungen und Erwartungen, und widersprichst einem Kunden freundlich, wenn er falsch liegt.
Digitale Tools sind für dich selbstverständlich. Ein neues System bringst du dir selbst bei, statt auf eine Schulung zu warten.

Sprout Social is looking to hire a Customer Success Manager, Key Accounts for the Sales & Customer Experience team.

s.h: Why join Sprout’s Sales & Customer Experience team?
s.t:
The Sales and Customer Experience team shapes how Sprout powers the future of customer connection for today’s most innovative brands. We sell and support the leading social media management platform for businesses, helping organizations unlock the full value of social. Through powerful social intelligence and trusted partnership, we enable teams to build authentic relationships and drive meaningful business impact.
You’ll join a high-performing, collaborative team made up of some of the brightest minds in the industry, working with iconic brands like Campbell's, Salesforce, Airbnb, and Equifax. Just as importantly, Sprout is a place where your growth matters. You’ll have the freedom to shape your career, explore new paths, and build toward what’s next, with a team that’s invested in helping you get there.

Own a book of ~60 Enterprise accounts — building relationships, driving adoption, and growing revenue within some of our largest, most strategic customers. The Customer Success Manager, Key Accounts plays a critical role in driving value through Sprout’s Social Intelligence platform.
Grow the relationship. Build strong, lasting relationships with key stakeholders — C-level executives, marketing directors, social media managers, and agency partners.
Bring a commercial mindset. Uncover new opportunities, qualify upsell and cross-sell leads, and confidently work through objections to expand accounts and defend revenue at renewal.
Run the cadence. Lead Mutual Success Plan reviews, monthly syncs, Executive Business Reviews, and adoption sessions to track usage, surface risks, and align on strategic goals.
Drive adoption. Partner with Onboarding and Professional Services to ramp new customers, and deliver ongoing training that keeps value visible throughout the client lifecycle.
Manage risk and retention. Spot churn risks early, resolve them proactively, and keep satisfaction high across your book. Collaborate effectively with Renewal Managers.
Tell the story with data. Track account health and key metrics, and turn them into a clear, compelling ROI narrative for customers and internally.
Work smart. Use generative AI tools like Claude and Gemini to speed up daily work — call prep, troubleshooting, drafting client messaging — so you can focus your time on the strategic parts of the job only you can own.
Hit your numbers. Consistently meet and exceed quota, managing your book against KPIs and your comp plan.

4+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, or Sales in B2B SaaS, including 2+ years managing an Enterprise book of business.
Strong preference for candidates with prior account management or sales experience — comfortable qualifying leads, uncovering opportunity, and navigating objections in commercial conversations.
Demonstrated success retaining, renewing, and expanding Enterprise accounts through strategic relationship management.
Experience building relationships with, presenting to, and influencing senior decision-makers.
Familiarity with generative AI platforms (e.g., Claude, Gemini) and comfort integrating them into daily operations — call prep, troubleshooting, messaging — to work more efficiently, while retaining full ownership and leadership of strategic client engagements.

Experience advising on social media strategy or tools.
Experience working with or managing agency partners is a plus.
Familiarity with G-Suite, Salesforce, Gainsight and Tableau.
How you’ll grow

s.h: Within 1 month, you’ll plant your roots, including
s.t:
Complete Sprout Social ’s new hire training & onboarding program alongside other new Sprout team members. You’ll gain a broader understanding of our products and how your role fits into the organization.
Partner with the Manager of Customer Success to define key success metrics for your role and how you will measure against them.
Begin developing familiarity with our business, platform, and applications, as well as our company’s key metrics.
Acclimate yourself with the day to day responsibilities of Sprout’s Success Team by shadowing team members, listening to recorded customer calls and working closely with our dedicated Enablement Manager.

s.h: Within 3 months, you’ll start hitting your stride by
s.t:
Receive your dedicated book of business and begin familiarizing yourself with your customer base.
Establish relationships with customer-facing departments across the organization.
Direct customers to Sprout resources such as product guides, webinars, and customer support to encourage product adoption.
Respond to high-impact customer issues in a fashion that inspires continued customer loyalty.
Actively handle inbound requests and account related questions.

s.h: Within 6 months, you’ll be making a clear impact through
s.t:
Maintain product expertise across our platform to serve as the ultimate trusted advisor.
Partner with colleagues across departments to address customer feedback and communicate accordingly.
Review to-date performance with your manager, identify areas of improvement and establish a plan for career development.

s.h: Within 12 months, you’ll make this role your own by
s.t:
Propose and execute independent projects benefiting the whole of Customer Success or Sprout as an organization.
Identify individual strengths and how to apply them effectively for continued success.
Master the Strategic Business Review and begin visiting customers in person to provide additional value.
Of course what is outlined above is the ideal timeline, but things may shift based on business needs and other projects and tasks could be added at the discretion of your manager.
